scholarships.title: TaiwanICDF Scholarship Program (Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund International Higher Education Scholarship)
scholarships.degree: Higher education in Taiwan (specific degree levels are not itemised in the HTML programme page; they are listed in the annual Application Guidebook PDF)
scholarships.official_source: Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF)

existing.description: TaiwanICDF's International Higher Education Scholarship Program awards full scholarships so that students from partner countries can study in Taiwan at universities that collaborate with the Fund through the Taiwan International Cooperation Alliance (TICA) framework. The Fund publishes the 2027 application round as 1 December 2026 to 15 March 2027 and requires every applicant to file through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System. The Fund states the programme supports the socio-economic growth of partner countries, cultivates talent, enhances the internationalisation of Taiwanese universities and broadens Taiwanese students' global perspective.
existing.program_type: Development-aid scholarship from an international cooperation fund
